primary_programme_comparison: R3 versus strong conventional B3; not evaluated in this diagnostic
diagnostic_comparison: R2 baseline-continuation partial resetting versus jointly tuned B3
selection_endpoint: expected ledger PnL minus separately reported design risk penalty
primary_money_diagnostic: paired session raw PnL, fees and settlement included
budget_limits: Equal candidate evaluations; CPU time measured separately, not claimed equal. B1/B2 duplicate inapplicable hedge settings retained in budget logs.
training: Exact expectation under explicit synthetic model; no seeds used for tuning, no estimation/data identification claim
frozen_quote_ablation: R2 retains B3 inventory quote map, changes only partial reset target selection
joint_tuning: Independently select B3 and R2 settings from the same 48 candidates
opponent_stress: Freeze balanced-model policies, evaluate in informed and persistent kernels; no policy access to changed latent atoms
inference: Descriptive paired session bootstrap per regime, unadjusted exploratory comparisons; exact model expectations reported separately
